blocks.prompt: 12. The sum of three numbers in an A.P. is 24 and their product is 440. Find the numbers.
blocks.explanation:
Teen anjaan numbers hain jo A.P. mein hain. Un ka jama aur product (zarb) diya hai.
Diya kya hai? Jama 24 aur product 440.
Find kya karna hai? Teeno numbers.
Plan: numbers ko \(a - d,\ a,\ a + d\) maanna. Jama se \(a\) foran mil jayega, phir product se \(d\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: teen numbers A.P. mein, jama \(= 24\), product \(= 440\).
Humein find karna hai: numbers.
Tareeqa: Agar numbers ko \(a,\ a + d,\ a + 2d\) maanein to equations lambi aur mushkil ho jati hain. \(a - d,\ a,\ a + d\) maanne se jama mein \(d\) cancel ho jata hai, aur product mein \((a - d)(a + d) = a^2 - d^2\) ban jata hai. Isi symmetric chunao se sawal aasaan ho jata hai.

Jama istemal karein
\[(a - d) + a + (a + d) = 24\]
\[3a = 24\]
\[a = 8\]
Kyun: \(-d\) aur \(+d\) cancel ho gaye, aur beech wala number seedha 8 mil gaya. Yaad rakhiye: teen numbers A.P. mein hon to beech wala unka average hota hai, \(24 \div 3 = 8\).

Product istemal karein
\[(a - d)\,a\,(a + d) = 440\]
\[8(64 - d^2) = 440\]
Kyun: \((a - d)(a + d)\) "difference of squares" formula se \(a^2 - d^2\) hai, aur \(a = 8\) rakha to \(64 - d^2\). Beech wala \(a = 8\) bahar multiply ho raha hai.

\(d\) nikalein
\[64 - d^2 = 55\]
\[d^2 = 9\]
\[d = \pm 3\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 8 se divide kiya (\(440 \div 8 = 55\)). Phir \(d^2 = 64 - 55 = 9\). Square root lete waqt dono signs: \(d = 3\) ya \(d = -3\).
Dhyan dein: \(d = -3\) ko chhoriye nahi; woh wohi numbers ulti tarteeb mein deta hai, aur answer key dono likhti hai.

Numbers likhein
\[d = 3:\ 5,\ 8,\ 11\]
\[d = -3:\ 11,\ 8,\ 5\]
Kyun: \(a = 8\) aur \(d\) ki har value \(a - d,\ a,\ a + d\) mein rakhi. \(d = 3\) se barhti hui A.P. aur \(d = -3\) se ghatti hui A.P.

Tasdeeq
\[5 + 8 + 11 = 24 \;\checkmark\]
\[5 \times 8 \times 11 = 440 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jama 24 aur product \(40 \times 11 = 440\); dono shartein poori. Aur 5, 8, 11 mein farq 3, 3 hai, yani A.P. bhi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(5,\ 8,\ 11\) ya \(11,\ 8,\ 5\)
Dono ek hi numbers hain, sirf tarteeb ulti hai.
